name: Amazon EC2: virtual servers, instance types and AMIs

lesson.summary: Amazon EC2 gives you virtual servers in the cloud that you can launch, stop and terminate on demand, paying only for the time they run. Launching an instance means choosing an instance type (its CPU, memory, network and storage mix) and an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that holds the operating system and any software. Instance types are grouped into families for general, compute, memory, accelerated and storage-heavy workloads.
keyPoints: Amazon EC2 provides virtual servers (instances) that you can launch, stop and terminate on demand
Launching an instance requires an instance type and an AMI
An AMI includes the operating system, storage setup, architecture, launch permissions and any pre-installed software, and can launch many identical instances
General purpose instances balance compute, memory and networking for web services and code repositories
Compute optimized instances suit compute-intensive work such as high performance computing, machine learning and scientific modeling
Memory optimized instances suit large in-memory datasets, analytics and databases
Accelerated computing instances use hardware accelerators such as GPUs for graphics processing and machine learning
Storage optimized instances give high throughput for large databases, data warehousing and I/O-heavy applications
Multi-tenancy means several customers share physical hardware while their workloads stay isolated
AWS tools to call services: the Management Console (web interface), the AWS CLI (commands and scripts) and the AWS SDK (code in a programming language)

scenarios.text: A university research team runs climate simulations that need a lot of raw CPU power for each calculation, and the simulations do not need much memory or GPU acceleration.

questions.prompt: What must you choose when you launch an Amazon EC2 instance?

options.text: The number of users who will log in
The instance type and the Amazon Machine Image (AMI)
The data transfer limit and the backup schedule
A physical server that you buy before launch

questions.explanation: An EC2 instance is launched from an AMI and runs on an instance type. The number of users, data transfer limits and physical servers are not required launch choices.

questions.prompt: Match each instance family with the workload it is designed for.

pairs.right: Balanced web services and code repositories
High performance computing and scientific modeling
GPU graphics processing and machine learning
High-throughput local storage for data warehousing

questions.explanation: Each family is tuned for one kind of resource: balanced for general use, CPU for compute-intensive work, memory for in-memory data, hardware accelerators for GPU workloads, and local storage throughput for storage-heavy work.

questions.prompt: Which instance family is the best fit for the research team in this scenario?
questions.explanation: Compute optimized instances give high CPU performance for compute-intensive tasks. The scenario does not mention large memory needs, GPUs, or heavy storage throughput, so the other families fit less well.

questions.statement: An AMI can include the operating system and pre-installed software, and one AMI can launch several identical instances.
questions.explanation: True. An AMI holds the operating system, storage setup, architecture, launch permissions and any extra software, so one AMI can start many instances with the same setup.

questions.prompt: Which AWS tool lets a developer call AWS services from application code written in a programming language?
questions.explanation: The AWS SDK provides language libraries so application code can call AWS services. The Console is a web interface for people, and billing statements and hardware keys are not provisioning tools.

questions.prompt: On an Amazon EC2 instance, which TWO tasks belong to the customer? (Choose two.)

options.text: Physical security of the data center

questions.explanation: On an unmanaged service like EC2 the customer patches the guest OS and configures firewall rules such as security groups. AWS handles the data center's physical security and the underlying hardware.

questions.prompt: What does multi-tenancy mean in the context of Amazon EC2?

options.text: Each instance runs on its own dedicated physical server forever
Several customers share the same physical hardware while their workloads stay isolated
Instances can only be used in one Region
Each instance has its own private network with no internet access

questions.explanation: Multi-tenancy means several customers share physical hardware, with each customer's workloads kept isolated. Dedicated hosts are the option for exclusive physical servers, and Regions and private networks are separate topics.

questions.prompt: Type the EC2 instance family that uses hardware accelerators such as GPUs.
questions.explanation: Accelerated computing instances use hardware accelerators such as GPUs to handle graphics processing and machine learning efficiently.
